requirements.quote: Add `windowsHide: true` to every `spawn`/`spawnSync` call (it is a no-op off Windows), and add a lint or test that rejects `detached: true` without it.
Add `windowsHide: true` to every `spawn`/`spawnSync` call (it is a no-op off Windows)
requirements.why: Non-detached children inherit the hidden console of their detached parent, so only detached roots open windows; blanket edits to ~70 other sites are churn. R1 covers every detached site and the guard test; a follow-up can sweep the rest if a window is still observed.

requirements.quote: `forgedock orchestrate 1 2 --foreground` on Windows opens no console windows
requirements.why: Only observable on a Windows 11 desktop; CI is Linux.
